question: Data: Boys taking Math= 19, Boys taking Math Lit= 17, Girls taking Math= 13, Girls taking Math Lit= 13. A learner is selected at random and it is known that they take Math. What is the probability that this learner is a Girl? (Give as a decimal rounded to 2 decimal places).
explanation: This is conditional probability. Total taking Math = 19 + 13 = 32. Number of Girls taking Math = 13. P(Girl | Math) = 13 / 32 = 0.41.
